core_obligations: Compact implies finite total dimension: the finite projective graded representative has finite dimensional pieces.
Converse: truncate to a single finite dimensional module M; M is artinian over R, so it suffices to handle the n+1 simple modules.
The explicit right ideals P_i give R as a direct sum of compacts; short exact sequences induct the simples into the compact subcategory.
